page.content:
Rocket engineer who led Saturn V development at Marshall.

How Wernher von Braun connects

  • Item: Saturn V — Wernher von Braun led the Marshall team that built Saturn V.
  • Location: Marshall Space Flight Center — Von Braun directed Marshall Space Flight Center in the Saturn years.

What is Wernher von Braun?

Wernher von Braun headed the Army ballistic team that became NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center and directed the Saturn family that lofted Apollo. His German V-2 past is part of the same documented career that made the Moon rocket.

Key threads lead to Saturn V and Marshall Space Flight Center.
